happening.subject: actor/the-sleeper
happening.text: A still shape waits on the porch floor.

why: A `spawn-actor` written for `actor/the-sleeper` just ahead of its `unleash-actor`. The warden enters by digging up out of the floor, and a body that enters has no puppet life: a caged warden standing on the porch first would be the thing the party sees, and the client is told of a body even when it stands for no tick. The refusal names the actor, the surface and where it is written, and prescribes removing it — the body's first appearance is its `unleash-actor`. It declares no unit: the primary binds `actors[].entrance`.
